members.reason: ["Missing source: the current text of the Arctic Research and Policy Act of 1984 (15 U.S.C. 4101-4111, as amended; Pub. L. 98-373 title I and later amendments such as Pub. L. 101-609) is not held (no 15 U.S.C. section text in jobs/current-law/output/usc-sections and no 98 Stat. 1242 or 104 Stat. 3184 text in jobs/selden-statutes). Without it the claim cannot decide whether the statute now fixes the Commission's membership, the Interagency Committee's membership and the report schedule differently from EO 12501 sections 2(a), 4(b), 8 and 9(b), so those clauses cannot be given a supported state on 2026-10-14.", "The order itself was not revoked: it is printed in the U.S. Code release point 119-121 as a note to 15 U.S.C. 4101 as amended only by EO 13286 section 45, and the Arctic Research Commission's Notice of Vacancy, 91 FR 13817 (March 23, 2026), cites EO 12501 as providing authority. ["Missing source: the text of the statute that abolished the United States Information Agency and transferred its functions (Foreign Affairs Reform and Restructuring Act of 1998, Pub. L. 105-277 div. G; 22 U.S.C. 6531, 6532 and 6551, which the U.S. Code note to 19 U.S.C. 2602 cites for the abolition, transfer of functions and treatment of references) is not held; 112 Stat. 2681 is not in jobs/selden-statutes and no 22 U.S.C. section text is in jobs/current-law/output/usc-sections. EO 12555 section 1 delegates the functions of the Convention on Cultural Property Implementation Act to the Director of the United States Information Agency and sections 2 and 3 require consultation with that Director. The abolition date and the statutory treatment of references to the Director are needed to decide whether section 1 and the USIA consultation duties continued, were transferred or ended, so no clause of section 1 can be given a supported state on 2026-10-14.", "The order was not revoked: the U.S. Code release point 119-121 prints it as a note to 19 U.S.C. 2602 as amended by EO 13286 section 44 (effective March 1, 2003), and State Department Delegation of Authority No. 236-3 (65 FR 53795, September 5, 2000) lists 'The functions in Executive Order 12555 of March 10, 1986' among the functions delegated within the Department of State. Operative force of at least sections 2 to 4 is likely, but section 1 cannot be decided from held sources."]
